description:
Decode the configured content format into its enum once, with exact tokens only.

## Background

`ValidationConfig.content_format` is `Option<String>` (`crates/jit/src/config.rs:274`), re-parsed by `content_format()` (`:283`). `ContentFormat::from_str` accepts `md` and any case (`domain/types.rs:224-237`). CLI parse sites are `main.rs:3011,3611`. The configuration reference lists only the canonical tokens.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `ContentFormat` is declared through the macro, and `ValidationConfig.content_format` is `Option<ContentFormat>` decoded by serde.
- [hard] REQ-02: The `md` alias and case folding are gone, and an unknown format fails configuration loading or CLI parsing with an error naming the value.
- [hard] REQ-03: The re-parse in `content_format()` is gone.
title: Content format is typed at load
